findings.title: Exact item portions must survive native reconstruction and disposition

evidence.claim: Inventory identity is id/components plus optional quality; the key is memoized.
Reconstruction destructures only id/components/quality and recreates template equipment.
Publication reconstructs key/count inventory; envelope writes counts.
A custody entry blocks disposition of the entire matching key.
Item/transfer effects reject matching equipped keys and key-level loans.
Chest correctly permits bag spares alongside equipment, while rejecting equipped-only and stale requests.
Cargo already validates explicit custody allocations and separates owned/borrowed quantity slices.
C2 already proposes lot/provenance conservation, separate custody and compatible native aggregation.

findings.current_player_behavior: Same-type/quality stock is aggregated. A player holding both owned and loaned copies cannot selectively dispose of the owned portion through key-level guards. Bag spares transfer through the chest despite a worn same-key copy; generic simulation item effects reject a matching equipped key. Extra JSON properties alone are not durable native specimen support.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: Resolve a selected owned/loaned/reserved/installed portion against one authoritative stock owner and expected revision. Use bulk counts for indistinguishable goods, lots for condition/provenance distinctions and stable specimens for unique/installed objects. Project those references into existing bag/chest/equipment/cargo consumers; preserve visible aggregation without losing the actual selection.

authoritative_owner.proposed_writer: Engine integrates identity/projection/native/save consumers; Items specifies object/lot rules; master selects compatibility.

world_example.case: Two owned survey kits and one loaned identical kit share a display row. Craft with an owned kit, return the lender’s kit, and preserve an equipped same-type spare distinction. No kit exists twice.

acceptance_case.positive: Consume one selected owned portion and deposit an owned bag spare while its sibling remains installed.
acceptance_case.adverse: Reject spending the loaned/reserved/installed portion and an old selection revision without changing stock.
acceptance_case.retention: Split/merge/transfer/import/reload keeps total quantities, legal claims and the same unique specimen; old ordinary keys retain their selected compatibility.

findings.title: Native crafting and consumption need the existing staged publication boundary

evidence.claim: stageAcquisition validates all debits against initial owners before grants within its call.
Simulation start spends costs before frozen output and seeded outcome selection on a plan.

findings.proposed_player_behavior: Stage the whole selected native craft/use result, including input debits, XP/unlocks, statistics, active effects, recovered containers and RNG state. Validate initial required stock and selected support before any output becomes available. Persist the combined envelope, then publish. Preserve level-by-level craft skill transitions and current no-op consumption rules rather than silently replacing their outcomes.

findings.title: Active artifacts and deployed consumables need actual object-bound execution and aftermath

evidence.claim: Native Artifact defines an equipment slot and authored stats.
UsableItem defines effects and recovery, without deployment identity/target fields in this constructor.
Inspected native use handles player template effects, not a generic throw/fire/place/arm operation.
Unique claims and definition-backed conditions provide reusable conservation/effect support.

findings.current_player_behavior: Passive native artifact stats and player consumables are implemented in these paths. They do not demonstrate a relic with active sensing/flight/ward/anchor operation, an attuned evolving object, a sentient object controller, projectile ammunition or a consumed token that leaves a persistent placed ward.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: An object mode binds the actual held/equipped/installed specimen, operator/control/attunement where applicable, support/cost, target/contact and effect. A one-use scroll/talisman/mixture debits its dose and creates the declared effect or one actual deployed object with location, owner/controller, trigger/expiry and cause. Charged, rechargeable, passive, evolving, cursed or living artifacts retain their particular lifecycle rather than sharing universal charges/binding/slot limits. Powers executes functions; Combat resolves tactical use; Items owns the object and consumed/deployed relationship.

authoritative_owner.proposed_writer: Items owns object modes/refinement/deployment material; Powers owns active execution/controller; Combat owns aim/contact/trigger; Engine binds native publication and persistence.

world_example.case: A retained signal lens spends its actual stored charge to detect a supported nearby mark. A one-use ward strip becomes a placed protection object at a specific worksite. Retrieving the surviving frame is distinct from refunding the consumed inscription.

acceptance_case.positive: Passive relic bonuses remain effective; the lens observes only supported signals; the real placed ward protects its eligible target for its declared duration.
acceptance_case.adverse: Cannot use a sold/loan-forbidden/unsupported relic or arm the same strip twice. Breaking the placed ward removes its dependent protection while leaving independent ordinary aftermath intact.
acceptance_case.retention: RNG/output/debit and deployed identity commit once; equipment swaps, travel, expiry/reload preserve actual charge, location/controller and irreversible spend.

findings.title: Containers, manuals and access objects must separate contents, knowledge and permission

evidence.claim: Native BookData/Book provide reading time, accumulated progress and rewards, looked up by book name.
Reading can unlock actual medicinal recipes without creating ingredients.
Potion production consumes a Glass phial as a material input.
Native recovery can produce a phial and removes the used potion dose.
Cargo reads actual bag/equipment/custody references; that API does not itself establish arbitrary nested container contents.
Attributed knowledge and held/settled claims have distinct records.

findings.current_player_behavior: Native books already teach/unlock, and phials participate in potion production/recovery. Bulk inventory and the inspected cargo API do not establish a general nested-content graph, preserved liquid contents, private physical notes or issuer-qualified key/license permission simply from item possession.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: Selected containers hold references to actual content portions with declared containment/preservation/capacity rules; filling/emptying/transfer never duplicates children. Source-qualified spatial storage binds a supported boundary/endpoint rather than copying bag counts. Manuals/maps/formulas convey declared knowledge through reading/observation; keys/seals/licenses reference the actual lock/issuer/claim and use/revocation rules. Physical evidence, understood information and institution permission remain separate owners. Old ordinary book progress retains chosen compatibility.

authoritative_owner.proposed_writer: Items owns containment/material/information object references; Society owns issuer/disclosure; Realm/Engine owns spatial boundaries and native stock/save binding.

dependencies: spatial boundary support only if selected

world_example.case: Carry three balm doses in a sealed preservation vessel, lend the vessel under stated contents terms, and return its surviving contents. Reading a repair manual unlocks instruction; an institution’s key opens its authorized cabinet without granting ownership of the cabinet’s stock.

acceptance_case.positive: Contents move with the same vessel exactly once under the selected custody policy; learned instruction remains while the book can be transferred; an authorized key opens its specific lock.
acceptance_case.adverse: An empty vessel supplies no dose; nested cycles/ambiguous ownership reject; a copy/name/expired license supplies no issuer right unless the local source rule permits it.
acceptance_case.retention: Transfer/reload/return retains sealed contents and current condition/claims; selling a book does not erase learned knowledge or duplicate reading rewards; revoked access does not erase historical learning.
